words.meaning: 务实的；讲求实效的；实用的
words.enExample: The new manager took a pragmatic approach to solving the team's backlog, focusing on what would actually work this quarter.
words.zhExample: 新经理采取了务实的办法来解决团队的积压任务，专注于本季度真正能见效的方案。
words.note: 词根 prag-（行动）+ -matic。idealistic 是"理想的"，pragmatic 是"看落地"的。面试谈规划时常见：We need a pragmatic timeline, not an ideal one.

words.meaning: 减轻；缓解（痛苦、压力、问题等）
words.enExample: A short walk outside after lunch can often alleviate the stress of a long workday.
words.zhExample: 午饭后出去散个步，常常能缓解漫长工作日的压力。
words.note: al-（加强）+ levi（轻）+ -ate，使变轻 = 减轻。和 relieve 近义，但 alleviate 更正式，书面、报告里更常用。搭配 alleviate pain / stress / burden。

words.enExample: The updated policy incorporates feedback from employees across all departments.
words.zhExample: 更新后的政策吸纳了来自各部门员工的反馈意见。
words.note: in-（进入）+ corpor（团体）+ -ate，并入一个整体。常见搭配 incorporate feedback / incorporate new ideas into... 比 include 多了"真正融合"的意味。

words.meaning: 茁壮成长；兴旺；蓬勃发展
words.enExample: Plants thrive when they get enough sunlight and the right amount of water.
words.zhExample: 植物在获得充足阳光和适量水分时会长得格外茂盛。
words.note: 古北欧语 þrífa，意指"成长、兴旺"。常见搭配 thrive in（...中如鱼得水）/ thrive on（靠...越活越带劲）。She thrives on challenges. 是面试中的高分金句。

words.enExample: The deadline for submitting the application is next Friday at 5 PM.
words.zhExample: 提交申请的最后期限是下周五下午 5 点。
words.note: dead（死的）+ line（线）→ 美国南北战争期间监狱的死线，引申为不可逾越的期限。职场高频：meet a deadline（按时完成）/ miss a deadline（误期）/ tight deadline（紧迫期限）。

essay.title: The Last Warm Page of Summer
essay.author: 佚名
paragraphs: The calendar still says August, but the evenings have begun to change their mind. The light arrives a little earlier in the morning and leaves a little sooner at dusk, as if summer were quietly closing a book it is not quite finished with.

You can feel it in small things. The crickets are louder now, as though trying to be remembered. The shade under the trees has grown greener, cooler, less like a refuge and more like a habit. Even the ice in your glass seems to melt with less urgency, as if it too knows the heat will not last.

There is a particular sadness to late summer, gentle and without regret. It is the sadness of a good letter you are reluctant to finish, of a road trip whose last miles feel both wanted and unwanted. We call it nostalgia, but it is really just attention — the sudden awareness that a thing is passing, and that passing is what makes it precious.

So let the season teach you. Do not rush to autumn. Sit once more on the steps as the air turns blue, and let the warmth settle into your shoulders like a hand you will miss. Summer does not end all at once; it leaves a little every evening, trusting you to remember the rest.
translations: 日历上仍写着八月，可黄昏已开始改变主意。晨光来得略早，暮色退得稍快，仿佛夏天正悄悄合上一本尚未读完的书。
你能在细微处察觉。蟋蟀此刻叫得更响，像是要被人记住。树荫变得更绿、更凉，少了几分庇护所的味道，多了几分习惯。就连杯中的冰，也融得少了些急切，仿佛它亦知暑热不会长久。
夏末有一种特别的哀愁，温柔而无悔。那是一封好信你舍不得读完的惆怅，是一段公路旅行最后几英里既盼又怕的心境。我们称之为怀旧，其实那只是专注——骤然意识到某物正在离去，而正是离去，让它变得珍贵。
那么就让季节教你。别忙着奔向秋天。当空气转蓝，再在台阶上坐一回，让暖意落进肩头，像一只你会想念的手。夏天并非一夕结束；它每个黄昏都留下一点，相信你会记得其余。

grammar.point: as if + 虚拟语气（were closing…）
grammar.example: "…as if summer were quietly closing a book it is not quite finished with."
grammar.note: as if 引导方式状语从句，当所述与现在事实相反时用“were + 现在分词/形容词/名词”的虚拟语气。此处 summer 并非真的在“合书”，故用 were closing 表虚构的拟人画面。 举一反三：He talks as if he were the only one who knew. （他说得仿佛只有他知道似的。）

grammar.point: 省略关系代词的定语从句
grammar.example: "It is the sadness of a good letter (that / which) you are reluctant to finish…"
grammar.note: 先行词 letter 在从句中作 finish 的宾语，关系代词 that / which 可省略。这是口语与文学中极常见的“宾语关系代词省略”，让句子更紧凑流畅。 举一反三：The book you lent me changed how I see the world.

grammar.point: 现在分词短语作伴随状语（trusting…）
grammar.example: "…it leaves a little every evening, trusting you to remember the rest."
grammar.note: trusting 是现在分词，逻辑主语仍是主句主语 it（夏天），表示与主句动作“leaves”同时发生的伴随状态/结果，相当于 and it trusts you…。现在分词作状语是让长句有画面感的关键技巧。 举一反三：She walked away, smiling at the memory.

grammar.point: that 引导的同位语从句
grammar.example: "…the sudden awareness that a thing is passing, and that passing is what makes it precious."
grammar.note: 抽象名词 awareness 后接 that 从句，解释“意识”的具体内容，这种从句叫同位语从句（注意与定语从句区分：that 不充当成分，仅起连接作用）。连续两个 that 从句并列，由 and 连接，节奏舒缓而有重量。 举一反三：The belief that tomorrow will be better keeps us going.

vocab.enExample: The light leaves a little sooner at dusk.
vocab.zhExample: 暮色退去得稍早了一些。
vocab.note: 用法：比 evening 更强调“天将黑未黑”的薄暮时分

vocab.enExample: He was reluctant to finish the good letter.
vocab.zhExample: 他舍不得读完那封好信。
vocab.note: 用法：be reluctant to do 不情愿做某事

vocab.enExample: We call it nostalgia, but it is really just attention.
vocab.zhExample: 我们称之为怀旧，其实那只是专注。
vocab.note: 用法：常指对过往温暖事物的眷恋

vocab.enExample: The shade is less like a refuge and more like a habit.
vocab.zhExample: 树荫少了几分庇护所的味道，多了几分习惯。
vocab.note: 用法：a refuge from… 躲避……的处所

vocab.enExample: The ice melts with less urgency, as if it knows.
vocab.zhExample: 冰融得少了些急切，仿佛它亦知。
vocab.note: 用法：with urgency 急切地；urgency 强调“必须马上做”的紧迫感

vocab.enExample: Her anger melted when she heard the truth.
vocab.zhExample: 听到真相，她的怒气便消散了。
vocab.note: 用法：及物/不及物皆可；引申义“（愤怒、疑虑）消散”

vocab.enExample: Passing is what makes it precious.
vocab.zhExample: 正是离去，让它变得珍贵。
vocab.note: 用法：precious to sb. 对某人而言珍贵；比 valuable 多一层“情感珍视”

vocab.enExample: Let the warmth settle into your shoulders.
vocab.note: 用法：settle into 渗入/落入（某处）；settle down 安定

vocab.enExample: Do not rush to autumn; sit once more.
vocab.zhExample: 别忙着奔向秋天，再坐一回。
vocab.note: 用法：rush to do 急着去做；rush sb. 催促某人

vocab.enExample: Summer leaves a little, trusting you to remember.
vocab.zhExample: 夏天留下一点，相信你会记得。
vocab.note: 用法：trust sb. to do 相信某人会（做）；此处拟人，夏天“信任”你记得
